tools.name: assign_conversation_ai
tools.description: Hand the conversation back to the AI agent.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get the connected workspace profile: name, behavior, timezone.

tools.name: get_workspace_snapshot
tools.description: Get the agent configuration exactly as the AI runtime receives it: identity, behavior, reply mode, enabled skills with secrets masked, conversation goals and QA counters.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List connected messenger accounts and bots.

activity_from.description: Filter by last message time-of-day start (HH:MM). Must be paired with activity_to

activity_to.description: Filter by last message time-of-day end (HH:MM). from > to = overnight

assigned_user_id.description: Filter by exact assigned workspace user

assignee.description: Filter by handler: ai (status<>manual) or operator (status=manual)

chosen_option.description: Filter dialogs where the client tapped this outbound button (callback_data, url, or text). Unknown value returns an empty list

date_from.description: Filter by last message calendar date start (YYYY-MM-DD, agent timezone)

date_to.description: Filter by last message calendar date end (YYYY-MM-DD, agent timezone)

funnel_stage_id.description: Filter by current goal UUID (the start goal also matches conversations with no funnel_state row)

platform.description: Filter by platform (telegram, instagram, max, avito, vk, zalo_bot, zalo_oa)

q.description: Search by platform user name (case-insensitive substring)

skill_id.description: Filter by a specific custom_api skill instance; takes precedence over skill

unread.description: If true, only conversations with incoming messages the calling user has not read

work_state.description: Filter by work queue state (todo, waiting, done). Applied before pagination

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List workspace users that conversations, deals and tasks can be assigned to.

after_id.description: Return the earliest messages strictly after this message ID
